name: Luna Hotel Baglioni
insider_take: This palazzo turned luxury hotel sits steps from St. Mark's Square, where centuries of Venetian history unfold at your doorstep.
whats_special: Luna Hotel Baglioni holds the distinction of being Venice's oldest hotel, welcoming guests since 1474. The property occupies a historic palazzo that once housed the Knights Templar, and its Canova Restaurant boasts stunning views of the Grand Canal. The hotel's prime location means you can walk to St. Mark's Basilica in under two minutes.
pro_tip: Request a canal-view room on the upper floors for breathtaking sunrise views over the Grand Canal, and book dinner at Canova during golden hour when the light reflects magnificently off the water.
dont_miss: The hotel's original Venetian terrazzo floors and period frescoes tell stories of nearly 550 years of hospitality. Step outside to explore the nearby Bridge of Sighs and Doge's Palace, or take a romantic gondola ride that departs just steps from the hotel's entrance on the Grand Canal.
pros: Prime location steps from St. Mark's Square
Historic Venetian palace with authentic architecture
Elegant rooms with classic Venetian décor
cons: Historic building with traditional room sizes
Premium pricing for central Venice location
